resources.string: Android doesn't list the control service Ruru needs on these headphones, so Ruru sent them nothing. They may not work with Ruru yet.
This phone doesn't have the sound effect Ruru's equaliser uses.

Works with music and video apps that tell Android about their sound, and only while sound goes to Bluetooth headphones. While it's on, Ruru keeps a small notification showing so Android doesn't stop it.
Also tries the phone's whole sound output, for apps that don't tell Android about their sound. Most phones don't allow it.
